item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find reliable 2024 evidence that Biden personally ordered retaliatory surveillance, blacklisting, or a federal campaign against peaceful protest organizers. The strongest negative evidence is not direct White House repression, but the campus-policing response around pro-Palestinian protests.
